answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its signal recurs, its zephyr survives audit, and a mirror from an unlinked peer confirms it.
